title: The Respectful Reporter
learning_focus: Visual stereotypes, cultural appropriateness, non-verbal cues, fact/opinion, multimedia purpose, and audience.
story_premise: A traveling reporter uses flashy images and exaggerated gestures that misrepresent both neighborhoods. The Pathfinder helps revise the broadcast.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Visual stereotypes, cultural appropriateness, non-verbal cues, fact/opinion, multimedia purpose, and audience.
